scope: Repair the D-5 claim-ceiling blocker by lowering foundation catalog security_review metadata that exceeded the preview-foundation ceiling.
claim: The claim-ceiling lane now passes because 44 foundation catalog records no longer claim self-reviewed security posture; they now declare security_review: unreviewed, matching the preview-foundation ceiling. Oya VCS verify/done/promote accepted this ChangeSet. Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required remains non-green because other D-5 lanes still fail.
